title: SignedStatement
description: The signed envelope of the private team store (ADR-014 section 3). Only the private-head kind is defined; the run statement kinds stay reserved until their slice. Each signature is Ed25519 over the JCS (RFC 8785) bytes of {"domain": "areneon/private-head/v1", "schema_version": 1, "body": ...}, so the schema version and the kind's domain string are inside the signed bytes. The statement's hash is SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the whole statement, signatures included. Verification is strict (RFC 8032): non-canonical encodings are rejected, S >= L included. The reader enforces what the profile cannot say: signatures sorted by key_id and unique, key_id equal to SHA-256 of the raw public key, object_digests sorted and unique, parent_head_hash null exactly for seq 1, and one signature unless next_public_key is set, then two, one of them by next_public_key. Which key may sign is the pin's decision, not the reader's.

kind.description: What the statement says. Only private-head is defined.

signatures.description: One or two signatures, sorted by key_id and unique (reader-enforced). Two only on a key rotation.

PrivateHeadBody.description: A private head: the latest committed private snapshot, linked to the head before it.

seq.description: The head's number: 1 for the first, plus 1 per commit.

parent_head_hash.description: The hash of the head at seq - 1; null exactly for seq 1 (reader-enforced).

issued_at.description: Unix seconds on the owner's clock.

snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of the JCS bytes of the PrivateSnapshotManifest: the physical identity.

logical_snapshot_hash.description: The writer-independent identity of the snapshot (ADR-013).

manifest_ciphertext_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the encrypted manifest object.

object_digests.description: The ciphertext_sha256 of every shard, sorted and unique (reader-enforced), at most 4096.

recipient_type.description: The age recipient type the objects are encrypted to.

next_public_key.description: Null, or the new signing public key (32 bytes as hex) during a rotation, when the head carries two signatures.

Signature.description: One Ed25519 signature and the public key that made it.

key_id.description: SHA-256 of the raw public key bytes, as hex (reader-enforced).

public_key.description: The raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, as hex.
